description: This file contains implementation of Orleans grains with implicit stream subscriptions, including the main grain class ImplicitSubscriptionCounterGrain and its derived classes FastImplicitSubscriptionCounterGrain and SlowImplicitSubscriptionCounterGrain, along with state management and subscription handling logic.

classes.name: ImplicitSubscriptionCounterGrain
classes.description: Main grain class implementing implicit stream subscription, state management, and event handling.

classes.name: MyState
classes.description: Serializable state class holding event and error counters and stream token.

classes.name: FastImplicitSubscriptionCounterGrain
classes.description: Derived class for fast implicit stream subscription.

classes.name: SlowImplicitSubscriptionCounterGrain
classes.description: Derived class for slow implicit stream subscription with delayed activation.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation logic, including delayed activation for slow variant.

methods.name: OnSubscribed
methods.description: Handles stream subscription and message processing.

methods.name: DeactivateOnEvent
methods.description: Sets whether to deactivate upon receiving an event.
